info.title: Native (Augmented) - mab
info.description: Augment/uses-resolved Native configuration for `mab` — branches contributed by external Cisco-IOS-XE-* modules (augments) and cross-module groupings that the base native generator does not resolve. Generated from the merged YANG tree. **Paths:** 12.

get.description:
Retrieve mab configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace mab configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update mab configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove mab configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
